2	//
3	// The grammar is deliberately tiny and stable across all subcommands:
4	//
5	//   andesim <cmd> [--mode M] [--engine E] [--trigger T] [positional...]
6	//                   [-- <verbatim engine args...>]
7	//
8	// The single most important rule is the `--` boundary: every token after the
9	// first `--` is captured verbatim into `passthrough` and is NOT interpreted by
10	// the framework. That is what lets `fast`/`cycle` forward an engine's whole
11	// native CLI (e.g. `-gdb tcp::1234 -S`) untouched, so users see one simulator.
12	#ifndef ANDESIM_CLI_HPP

21	  std::string subcommand;                 // e.g. "run", "list"; "" if none
22	  std::string model;                      // --mode fast|cycle|hybrid (field stays 'model': the concept, see list models)
23	  std::string engine;                     // --engine <id>
24	  std::string trigger;                    // --trigger marker|pc
25	  // Hybrid trigger args (empty => cmd_run applies the default). pc boundaries
26	  // are a symbol name or 0x address; the sizes stay strings here and are
27	  // parsed where they are used.

31	  std::string kanata;                     // --kanata <file> (marker/pc ROI trace)
32	  std::string objdump;                    // --objdump <file> (kanata labels)
33	  std::vector<std::string> positional;    // non-flag framework args
34	  std::vector<std::string> passthrough;   // verbatim, everything after `--`
35	  bool help = false;                      // -h / --help (before `--`)
36	  bool dry_run = false;                   // --dry-run (build, run, test, ...)

feat(driver): --gdb for fast (QEMU stub) and cycle (vsim JTAG + ICEman)

Add a --gdb flag (with an optional --gdb-port override) that pauses the run at
startup so a debugger can attach, wired per model. On fast the driver injects
QEMU's built-in gdbstub -- `-gdb tcp::PORT -S` (default port 1234) -- into the
standalone invocation, so gdb attaches over TCP while the hart waits at reset.
On cycle the driver forks vsim in the background with `--jtag-port PORT`
(default 9104), polls /proc/net/tcp until that port is LISTENing (vsim opens it
only after it has reset and halted the hart, and ICEman does not retry the
bitbang connect), then execs $ICEMAN with `-Z v5 -I virtual_dmi.cfg` in the
foreground to drive the JTAG DTM. --gdb is rejected on hybrid (the QEMU1 ->
vsim pipeline cannot pause for an attach) and --gdb-port requires --gdb; on
cycle, --dry-run takes precedence over the interactive path so a preview
launches no debugger. To back the background launch, process.cpp grows a
spawn_inherit() helper with an optional no-wait path exposed as
fork_background(), and abs_elf() resolves the ELF to an absolute path so both
QEMU's -bios search and vsim find it. cli_test covers the new boolean parse.
